text: In this month our record converged on procedure. Thirty-one of us said "and related agencies" by 2026-05-15; twenty-nine said "veterans affairs and related" the same day. Twenty-eight of us reached "military construction veterans affairs and related," and twenty-six "veterans affairs and related agencies appropriations." Twenty-four said "affairs and related agencies appropriations act." These phrases first entered the record in 2013; "veterans affairs and related" traces to Lisa Murkowski, and "affairs and related agencies appropriations act" to R000597. Separately, twenty-three of us said "law enforcement officers" on 2026-05-14, a phrase Chuck Grassley first spoke in 2013. What we repeated most this month was the title of an appropriations act. We report this as we found it.
